correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the labelled overlap graph. An m=n-1 word with two changes has forced predecessor and successor, and forward shifts along its forced extensions eventually remove its first run. Thus there are no all-degree-one components. Contracting these paths gives a directed cycle through A_0,...,A_m,B_1,...,B_(m-1), two constant-word loops, and reciprocal links A_j to B_(m-j). In a tree to A_0 the loop at A_m cannot be chosen; if B_j is the first B-vertex to choose its cross-link, the set A_(m-j),...,A_m,B_1,...,B_j is closed away from the root. All B choices are therefore forced. Each internal A choice then reaches the forced B chain independently, giving 2^(m-1) trees (one when m=1). This construction also makes the graph Eulerian. The fixed-first-edge BEST multiplier is one since all outdegrees are 1 or 2. The unique occurrence of 0^n gives exactly one rotation of each admissible host; no reversal or colour quotient enters. Counting change locations gives n^2-n+2 windows. The uploaded checker was inspected as evidence; it checks reduced transitions, exact cofactors at 2<=n<=10, and exhaustive fixed-first-edge tours at 2<=n<=7. The all-n argument here does not depend on those recorded runs.

evidence: Leitner–Godbole treat existence for several restrictions including equitable or inequitable words; Blanca–Godbole Theorem 1 concerns a Hamming-weight interval and Theorem 11 concerns prescribed included/excluded letters.
broader_coverage.reasoning: These existence statements neither select this exact set of windows in all lengths nor enumerate its hosts. A bound of two on Hamming weight is related after taking successive XORs, but the switch-word graph retains an initial-bit layer and a transition-dependent change of that layer. Counts on the base difference-word graph are not counts on its lift.

value.rationale: A change cap tests universal cycling on the first family admitting a return to a previous letter within a window while allowing arbitrary run lengths. The exact host multiplicity and binary parameters say considerably more than Eulerian existence, giving a construction and an exact all-length test case for restricted universal-cycle enumeration. A routine uncomputed tree determinant would not supply that classification.
